parameters.content:
## MiroMiro showcase: images, Elementor, a whole page as code and an AI agent

### How it works
Four ways to use MiroMiro in n8n, side by side. One click on **Run Manually** runs the first three: every image of a page downloaded into one zip, the hero of a page as an Elementor template for WordPress, and a whole page rebuilt as code, section by section, with a link to the page assembled. The fourth is a chat agent that uses MiroMiro as its tools. Each part stops with a clear message if its page cannot be read. Failed calls are not charged.

### Setup
This template uses the verified community node **n8n-nodes-miromiro** (tested with version 0.1.4 on n8n 1.123).
1. On n8n Cloud, search "MiroMiro" in the nodes panel (an admin may need to turn on Verified Community Nodes). Self-hosted: Settings > Community nodes > Install `n8n-nodes-miromiro`, see https://docs.n8n.io/integrations/community-nodes/installation/
2. Get a free MiroMiro API key (300 credits a month, no card): https://miromiro.app/api/onboarding
3. Open **Fetch Images from MiroMiro** > Credential > Create new, and paste the key.
4. Select the same credential in the other MiroMiro nodes and tools.
5. Click **Execute workflow**. For the agent, add a chat model credential in **Claude Chat Model** and click **Open chat**.

Images cost 1 credit per page, a section 10. The same call again within 24 hours is free.

### Customization
Change the URLs in each MiroMiro node. Every part is also its own template: download every image, a section in Elementor, a whole page as code and the AI agent. Delete the parts you do not need.

![The workflow, in case the preview does not load](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SoraiaBarroso/n8n-nodes-miromiro/main/docs/templates/miromiro-showcase.png)

parameters.content:
## 1. Download every image

Every image on the page, downloaded and zipped. Change the URL in **Fetch Images from MiroMiro**.

## 2. A section in Elementor

The hero as an Elementor template file to import in WordPress.

## 3. A whole page as code

Every section rebuilt and assembled. Open `pagePreviewUrl` on the last node.

## 4. MiroMiro as AI agent tools

Click Open chat and ask: "Turn the hero of linear.app into a React component".
